report: Experts Optimistic About the Next 50 Years of Digital Life
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Digital life in 50 years
entries.quote: The year 2019 will mark the 50th anniversary of the first host-to-host internet connection. Please think about the next 50 years. Where will the internet and digital life be a half century from now?
entries.subject: internet and digital life, long term
entries.note: The main prompt is open-ended; respondents also chose whether individuals' lives would see change for the better, change for the worse or no significant change. The exact wording of that closed choice is not printed on the report page. 50-year horizon read as 2069.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = change for the better; disagree = change for the worse

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
